thread:
maya: Heads up — a customer running on-prem KMS asked if Redwood can auto-sync entitlements after a BYOK rotation. They want zero-downtime unsealing and auditable evidence that we never saw key material. Any prior pattern?

 tom: We don't currently auto-sync for on-prem KMS. Agents pick up local key changes and customer pushes certs. Why do they need our side to sync?

 maya: They rotate their wrapping key frequently and want our agent to pick up new wrapping metadata + push a signed event to control plane so ops doesn't have to manual handoff. Also they require proof that we didn't persist the key.

 pradeep: Two immediate concerns: 1) RBAC delta propagation — we must ensure we don't escalate privileges when provisioning based on new entitlements. 2) Audit provenance — logs should capture KMS key fingerprint + attestation chain.

 isabella: Compliance constraints: SOC2/PCI require timestamped evidence of key rotation, operator identity, and rewrap operations. Logs must be tamper-evident and retained for >=1 year. Also need contractual language that Redwood is not custodian of customer key material.

 maya: Proposed approach: run a local agent watcher that extracts key metadata (not key material) and emits a signed entitlement event to control plane over mTLS. Control plane records event + signature, but never stores raw key bytes. Example event payload (signed):

```json
{
  "event_id": "evt-2026-03-20-01",
  "kms_key_id": "projects/../keys/abc123",
  "fingerprint": "sha256:deadbeef...",
  "nonce": "n-4f2b",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T15:12:03Z",
  "action": "rotation",
  "agent_cert_chain": "<base64-pem>"
}
```

 tom: Operational risk: if agent auto-applies entitlements we must gate any provisioning behind a deny-by-default RBAC check and require explicit 'apply' approval for new entitlement scopes. Also need rate-limits to avoid mass-provisioning during a bad rotation.

 derek-oncall: Incident angle — last week a failed rewrap caused ~8m of degraded traffic for a tenant. Can we add an ephemeral fallback to prior KV cache for short windows (10m) to avoid serving interruption when a rotation event fails?

 pradeep: Security triage — signed events introduce replay risk. Mitigations: include nonce + TTL, enforce one-time-use event IDs, and verify cert revocation via OCSP/CRL before accepting an event. Also HSM attestation verification if supported.

 maya: Agreed. Nonce + TTL + event_id in audit logs for correlation with traces. Also add signature verification and certificate chain validation with OCSP.

 isabella: For compliance we also need a "proof of non-retention" statement in onboarding docs and a sample log bundle format for legal review. I'll request sample entries from eng for contract exhibits.

 tom: Action items: 
- eng-security: draft signed-entitlement API spec (assigned @pradeep)
- eng-runtime: implement ephemeral fallback cache + gate (assigned @tom)
- product: update BYOK onboarding checklist + contract language (assigned @isabella)
- ops: tabletop for rotation incident scenarios (schedule with @derek-oncall)

 sec-bot: Runbook created: /runbooks/byok-entitlement-sync — assigned to @pradeep, @tom. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/byok-entitlement-sync

 maya: I'll spin up the design doc and include the sample event format and threat model. tagging @isabella for compliance bits. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
